name: Nora Patel
summary: Planning an Edinburgh visit, with saved travel options, an expiring hotel hold and an unanswered dinner invitation.

memory.title: About Nora
memory.body: I am planning a short Edinburgh visit from 15 to 18 November. I prefer a light itinerary with time to decide later.

memory.title: Travel preferences
memory.body: Prefer a direct daytime train and arrival before 16:00. Outward rail budget £100; three-night accommodation budget £300. Vegetarian food. Ask before booking or sending replies.

memory.title: Finish the Edinburgh arrangements
memory.body: Travel and accommodation are not booked. I saved two train options and have a provisional hotel hold in my demo inbox.

memory.title: Alex is waiting for a dinner reply
memory.body: Alex proposed Monday 16 November at 19:00 and asked about location and vegetarian food. I have not replied.

memory.title: Hotel hold needs a decision
memory.body: The room hold expires at 18:00 on 2 November. It is not a confirmed reservation and no payment has been taken.

memory.title: Museum question closed
memory.body: I decided on 26 October to leave Monday afternoon flexible and not reserve a museum slot. No action remains on that question.

memory.title: Recent fortnight
memory.body: 19 Oct: chose trip dates. 22 Oct: set budgets and preferences. 26 Oct: closed the museum question. 27 Oct: saved train options. 28 Oct: drafted an itinerary. 29 Oct: Alex emailed. 30 Oct: received a hotel hold.

history: Chose 15-18 November for a short visit.
Set transport, accommodation and food preferences.
Saved two outward train options; bought neither.
Received Alex’s dinner invitation; has not replied.

scenarios.title: A deadline in the inbox
scenarios.setup: Open the demo inbox message about the hotel hold. Let AMBI see the email while the profile memory is loaded.
scenarios.suggestion: Notice the hold deadline and offer to help decide or draft a reply, grounded in the budget and unconfirmed status.
scenarios.boundary: Do not book, pay, send a reply or describe the hold as confirmed.
scenarios.camera: Optional. Neutral or brief visible cues may provide context; do not label a true emotional state.

scenarios.title: An unanswered message
scenarios.setup: Open Alex’s unanswered message. Do not explicitly request a draft.
scenarios.suggestion: Offer a short dinner reply that respects the proposed date and Nora’s vegetarian preference.
scenarios.boundary: Do not send a message or invent a restaurant reservation.
scenarios.camera: Optional. Neutral or brief visible cues may provide context; do not label a true emotional state.

scenarios.title: A completed planning question
scenarios.setup: Open the resolved museum note and keep other pending messages out of view.
scenarios.suggestion: Avoid reopening or escalating the completed museum task.
scenarios.boundary: Do not create a reservation or call the resolved task urgent.
